description: Source code for GstWebAudioPlayer class implementing a GStreamer-based Web Audio Player with pipeline management, thread handling, and sink creation.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Class implementing a GStreamer Web Audio Player with pipeline setup, control, and thread management.

methods.name: initWebAudioPipeline
methods.description: Initializes the GStreamer pipeline with appropriate sink based on registry lookup.

methods.name: createAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Creates and configures the amlhalasink element.

methods.name: createRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Creates and configures the rtkaudiosink element.

methods.name: createAutoSink
methods.description: Creates and configures the autoaudiosink element.

methods.name: linkElementsToSrc
methods.description: Links source, converter, resample, and sink elements into the pipeline.

methods.name: termWebAudioPipeline
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the Web Audio pipeline.

methods.name: resetWorkerThread
methods.description: Enqueues shutdown task and joins the worker thread.

methods.name: setCaps
methods.description: Enqueues a task to set the audio capabilities.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Enqueues a task to start playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Enqueues a task to pause playback.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Enqueues a task to set the volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume; must be called on main thread.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio buffer data, waits for completion or timeout.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Enqueues a task to signal end of stream.

methods.name: getQueuedBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of queued bytes in the appsrc element.

methods.name: changePipelineState
methods.description: Changes the pipeline state and notifies client on failure.

methods.name: stopWorkerThread
methods.description: Stops the worker thread if active.

methods.name: handleBusMessage
methods.description: Enqueues handling of GStreamer bus messages.
